evidence: Has the Validation label, alters block loading during chain activation in `src/validation.cpp`, and directly affects block connection performance.
rationale: Prefetching blocks provides substantial and measured speedups to block connection and initial verification. Benchmarks show a 1.53x to 1.57x speedup on reindex-chainstate and a 1.13x speedup on full IBD, which was corroborated independently by a reviewer.
